notes: Rule 11, not settled: the unnamed group at Hushaym's level («أخبرنا غير، واحد، منهم مغيرة وفلان ورجل ثالث أيضا») names Mughira among its members; the surface is the unnamed phrase and the naming is left for a ruling.
«فكتب إليه المغيرة أني سمعته يقول» makes Mughira the last link of the first route: the saying is in his letter. Mu'awiya who wrote to him is in the scene.
«وعن هشيم أخبرنا عبد الملك بن عمير» is a second route to the same saying («هذا الحديث»), with Hushaym shared; «سمعت ورادا» is rule 5.
